'''Shadow Tech Armor''' was a heavily modified field version of the [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II armor]] worn by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. They were augmented with the use of advanced [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] technology and marked these [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] as elite veterans of the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]].

==Behind the scenes==
Shadow Tech Armor appeared in the game [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] in the [[:w:c:cwa:Battle of Umbara|Battle of Umbara]] combat zone. Small holograms hidden in the zone can be collected by the players. Completing a [[:w:c:cwa:Collection|collection]] of these holograms rewards players with a piece of wearable Shadow Tech armor.
